Overview

Vushtrri is a city in Mitrovica with a population of 27,000. A historic city in northeastern Kosovo known for its medieval Vushtrri Castle, the Stone Bridge, and its agricultural and forestry industries. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
